subject: Recap & commitment path — Redwood pilot for ClearView
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & commitment path — Redwood pilot for ClearView

Emma, thanks for the time today — appreciated the candidness from you and the leadership team. Quick recap from our side and suggested commitment path so your procurement team has something tangible to evaluate.

Key business objectives we captured:
- Reduce average time-to-first-insight for CareOps by ~70% via assisted summarization and reranking.
- Replace current on-prem NLU pipelines for triage to cut median intent-classification latency under 60ms per call.
- Keep PHI isolated; customer-managed KMS is a must.

Primary risks & mitigations we discussed:
- Data residency / auditability: Redwood Private (VPC) + audit logs retained for 2 years (option to extend). We'll provide SOC2 summary and evidence stubs for initial review (attached).
- Latency SLAs at peak: Dedicated pool with autoscaling + canary ramping. We'll instrument token-level latency traces for your SREs.
- Procurement timeline mismatch: propose a staged commercial path (pilot -> reserved capacity commit). Details below.

Recommended pilot commitment path (narrow, executable):
1) 8-week technical pilot (non-prod) — target 2M tokens/week, dedicated burst capacity.
2) Security review window (2 weeks) — provide SOC2 summary + SSO/SAML docs.
3) Commercial pilot terms: pilot discount + option to convert to 12-month reserved capacity with a 30-day notice.

Immediate next steps (action owners):
- Jonas (me): attach preliminary SOW and usage estimate; share SOC2 summary stub — by EOD today.
- Emma: introduce procurement/finance contact for contracting and commercial baseline (if possible).
- Marissa: loop in Solutions/Legal for SSO and data flow diagram follow-up.

Attachments included: redwood_prelim_sow_v1.pdf, usage_estimate_ClearView.xlsx, SOC2-summary-stub.pdf

Thanks again — will follow up with the SOW and a one-page commitment path for Luke/Procurement.

—
Jonas Weber

Team — forwarding ClearView's reply and procurement contact. They asked for SOC2 evidence mapping and SSO/SAML onboarding docs. I attached the preliminary SOW and the usage estimate we sent.

Key asks to resolve before engaging Luke: 
- Marissa: please prepare a SOC2 controls-to-artifacts one-pager (NDA-friendly) and identify which logs/artifacts we can hand off immediately.
- Monica: confirm the SAML onboarding steps and whether customer-managed KMS is supported for the VPC path (call out any lead time for HSM integration).
- Aditya: run a quick feasibility check on meeting the 2M tokens/week baseline in pilot with our Dedicated burst config; note any expected cost delta for that throughput.

Proposed procurement path (we'll present to Luke):
A) Pilot agreement (8 weeks) — reduced rate, access to Dedicated burst, standard PII addendum, right-to-audit clause.
B) Security review & evidence exchange — SOC2 mapping + SSO checklist (target 10 business days).
C) Conversion to reserved capacity — 12-month commit, price tiers based on sustained tokens/month.

Escalation items: 
- If SOC2 evidence requires more than 15 business days, surface to Emma and offer a scoped PoC without production data.
- If KMS/HSM integration has >30 day lead time, propose temporary hosted customer key arrangement and explicit sunset plan.

I'll draft the one-page procurement path doc for Luke; Marissa/Monica/Aditya, can you get your items into my inbox by EOD tomorrow?

Best,
Jonas

- 8-week technical pilot (non-prod) — target throughput: 2M tokens/week.
- Pilot commercial terms: 40% pilot credit (applied to first invoice if converted), standard PII DPA, option to convert to 12-month reserved capacity within 30 days post-pilot.

- SAML/SSO integration guide + onboarding matrix — Monica — ETA: 2026-11-19
- Customer-managed KMS options & lead times — Monica & Infra — ETA: 2026-11-20
- Evidence exchange window: target 10 business days once NDA in place.

Procurement checklist for Luke (to attach to any internal RFx):
- Attach: redwood_prelim_sow_v1.pdf, usage_estimate_ClearView.xlsx, SOC2-summary-stub.pdf
- Requested docs: SOC2 mapping + onboarding guide (deliverables above)
- Signature: DocuSign envelope for pilot SOW (we can create once procurement confirms legal contacts) — HubSpot deal: 9876543

Escalation triggers (if any):
1) SOC2 mapping takes >15 business days -> escalate to Jonas + Redwood CISO for prioritized evidence.
2) KMS/HSM requires >30 days -> propose temporary hosted key arrangement with explicit removal timeline.
3) Unresolved pricing delta >15% vs. estimate -> route to Commercial lead for exception approval.

Next immediate asks: 
- Luke: please confirm procurement primary contact and any internal RFx deadlines.
- Emma: permission to share limited SOC2 artifacts under NDA (Marissa will send the mapping).

I'll post the one-page commitment path and a redlined pilot SOW in the Drive folder and generate the DocuSign envelope once procurement confirms signers.
